scope: English Red/Blue (pokered default build), move IDs 1-165; direct move damage
review_method: Static source review of the pinned battle execution paths and effect handlers; no ROM or emulator execution.

label_definitions.regular_damage: direct damage follows normal base-power calculation, regardless of side effects
label_definitions.status: does not directly inflict attack damage; may cause indirect damage
label_definitions.special_damage: direct damage set from fixed value, level, HP, counter, accumulated damage, or OHKO
label_definitions.unknown: not sufficiently source-reviewed; candidate is not verified
